frequency_question: How often do major legislative principals successfully deliver complex structural economic/infrastructure reform bills before the end of a multi-year session window?
membership_rule: Includes major energy, telecommunications, or financial regulatory overhaul packages designated as priority legislative vehicles; excludes routine appropriations and minor amendments.

cases.name: Energy Independence and Security Act of 2007
Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act
Fiscal Responsibility Act of 2023 (Permitting provisions attempted)

coverage_note: 9 major structural omnibus attempts tracked over 30 years; 7 successfully enacted.
known_gaps: Excludes minor rider provisions attached strictly to must-pass defense authorizations unless substantive standalone reform was achieved.
validity_reason: Congressional polarization dynamics and omnibus reliance patterns shift slowly across multiple decade blocks.
